# S1.25 — Land the `hh-embed/1` contract (`R-2.11.4⁰ᵇ`): Groups H/S/W/R over the closed error sum, the §7.4 frame model, in-process + newline-JSON-RPC bindings with byte parity, typed negotiation + stability tiers, schema-level injection refusals, Group L signatures, and `hh-kernel serve` delegating to `hh-embed`

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §7.4 (`R-2.11.4⁰ᵇ`, C0/Stage-1 slice per §9)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/029_S1.25__sdk-embed-contract.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.11.4⁰ᵇ**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.24` (stacked) · **Stage:** 1 ·
**Live stage:** offline-only (all verification is the `cargo` suites)

## Summary
The Stage-1 public boundary is now canonical, not bespoke: `hh-embed/1`
declares every Group H/S/W/R operation against the closed `EmbedError`
sum and the §7.4 frame model; the in-process service and the newline-
delimited JSON-RPC stdio binding are one dispatch path over
`EmbedService::handle`, so a generated client drives
`hello → open_session(new) → submit → stream_events → close` identically
over either. `hh-kernel serve` delegates to `hh-embed` rather than
maintaining a parallel implementation (CC7).

### `hh-embed-schema` (the single schema source — extended, never duplicated)
- **Op registry** (`ops.rs`) — the full §7.4 verb table: Group H (`hello`),
  Group S (`open_session`/`close`/`list_leases`/`grant`/`revoke_lease`/
  `lineage`), Group W (`submit`/`cancel`/`respond_permission`/
  `report_host_effect`/`fork`/`steer`), Group R (`stream_events`/`read`/
  `head`/`project`/`account`/`describe`/`get_artifact`), Group L signatures
  declared at `experimental` tier with `AssumptionDebtRecord`s (§9:
  Stage-3 executables — opted-in calls answer `Refused{stage_pending}`).
- **Types** (`types.rs`) — `HelloParams`/`HelloResult` typed negotiation
  (`contract_major`, optional `schema_hash` pin, `kernel_floor`,
  `capabilities`), `OpenSpec{definition, environment, budgets, run_kind,
  overrides}`, `SessionMode{new|resume{continue|takeover}|attach}`,
  `RealizedSettings`, `AttendeeList`, `SubmitInput`/`TurnHandle`,
  `Cursor`, `RunSummaryRef`, `LeaseRecord`, `EnvironmentDescriptor`
  (`connection_info`/`health`/`meters`), `HostCapabilities`.
- **Frame sum** (`frames.rs`) — the §7.4 R-1…R-7 model:
  `durable{seq,hash,event}`, `sync{from_seq,through_seq,head_hash}`,
  `ephemeral{kind,scope,attempt,order,payload}`, `item_started`,
  `item_aborted`, `lagged{dropped,resume_from_seq}`, `closed{reason}`.
- **Closed error sum** (`errors.rs`) — `EmbedError` covering the §7.4
  table incl. `ContractMajorUnsupported`, `SchemaMismatch{direction}`,
  `KernelBelowFloor`, `ExperimentalRequired`, `CapabilityNotDeclared`,
  `WouldBlock{active_holder}`, `SessionDetached`, `SecretInPayload`,
  `AuthorityViolation{layer}`, `UnresolvedRef`, `Missing{Gc}`, and the
  permission/steer/fork refusal members; per-op declared subsets are
  checked as members of the sum.
- **Strict decoding** (`strict.rs`) — unknown non-`ext` fields refuse
  `UnknownField{path}`; `ext` slots pass through byte-for-byte (I2).

### `hh-embed` (new persistent crate — binding-neutral service + binding (b))
- **`service.rs`** — single dispatch: init → op lookup/direction →
  **experimental gate → capability gate** → implementation. Experimental
  ops answer `ExperimentalRequired` before `CapabilityNotDeclared` when
  the capability is also absent.
- **`open.rs`** — `open_session{new}` runs resolve → validate → seal →
  provision `local_host` (`EnvDriver`) → `open_run` under the fenced
  writer lease → arm `Driver<ReactMinimal>`; `resume{continue}` answers
  `WouldBlock{active_holder}` while a writer lives; `resume{takeover}`
  detaches the in-process writer, releases its lease, and carries the
  fenced session's live driver into the new session (the leaf continues —
  no `turn-1` re-mint); `attach` is read-only, never acquires a lease.
  `close` mints `lifecycle.session.detached`, releases the lease, and
  leaves subscriptions drainable so the terminal `closed{run_ended}`
  frame is observable.
- **`work.rs`** — `submit` mints the registered
  `context.artefact.delivered` record (`artefact_id`, `delivery_id`,
  `kind:"instruction"`, `by_reference`) and drives the turn through
  `KernelSink`; idempotent `submit` replays the recorded
  `Accepted{turn_id}`; `cancel` acknowledges and stops;
  `respond_permission` lands `security.permission.decided` with declared
  fields (`permission_id`, `proposal`, `decision`, `decider`) on a live
  `pending`; `report_host_effect`/`fork`/`steer` route through the
  driver.
- **`runtime.rs`** — deterministic Stage-1 ports: `EmbedModel`,
  `EmbedGate`, `EmbedAssembler` — `hh.submit` completes; declared
  host-executor surfaces defer `unknown{awaiting_host}` and ride
  `upcall.invoke_host_capability`; unbound surfaces refuse
  `surface_not_bound`.
- **`frames.rs`** — the 2.4 adapter: ledger durable events →
  `durable{seq,hash,event}` (hash verbatim); subscription replay → `sync`;
  `model.call.requested`/`failed` → `item_started`/`item_aborted`;
  lag markers → `lagged{dropped:{ephemeral}}`; store closure →
  `closed{run_ended|kernel_shutdown}`.
- **`inject.rs`** — schema-level refusals: runtime-handle keys
  (`runtime_handle_injection`), secrets scanned via `hh-secrets`
  (`SecretInPayload`), cap-widening overrides
  (`AuthorityViolation{layer:"override"}`).
- **`stdio.rs`** — binding (b): newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 loop over
  `EmbedService::handle` with `stream.frame` notification drainers — a
  framing layer only, never a second dispatch.

### `hh-control`
- `Driver::append` no longer stamps a closed `turn` scope on run-level
  terminal rows (`lifecycle.run.finished` mints run-scope) — previously
  every row carried `turn-1` and tripped the ledger's `ScopeNotOpen`
  gate; resume carries the live driver rather than re-minting `e-0`.

### `hh-codegen` + generated client
- `emit.rs` emits all message types/sums and the typed
  `Client<R, W>`: `call`, per-op typed methods, `poll_notification`/
  `take_notifications` (buffers `stream.frame` notifications while
  awaiting responses), and `hello` asserts negotiated
  `(contract_major, schema_hash)` against generated constants.
- Regenerated `schema/hh-embed-1.schema.json` +
  `crates/hh-embed-client-generated/src/generated.rs` (drift-checked, CC7).

### `hh-kernel`
- `serve` delegates to `hh_embed::stdio::serve`; `doctor`/`export-schema`
  unchanged; `codegen_round_trip` exercises the generated client over a
  live stdio `serve`; `hello_stdio` asserts the canonical
  `kernel{version,schema_hash,contract_major,idp}` shape.
